messages:
Eve (Events): Heads-up: stream health alert — encoder CPU trending high and preview lagging ~7s. Gonna ask for a 4-min pause and push Q&A to the end to avoid awkward gaps.
Ravi (AV): Confirmed CPU spike on encoder-3 (90%). Spinning up backup container and re-routing shortly.
Noah (Host): OK I'll pause presenters and tell attendees we're taking a short pause. Also will ask remote folks to drop questions here so we can triage priority.
Recorder Bot: Recording paused -> checkpoint saved at s3://redwood-allhands/checkpoints/3325809999/cp-01.json
Ravi (AV): Switching stream to backup-enc-1 now. Command run:
```
kubectl scale deployment encoder-3 --replicas=0
kubectl scale deployment backup-enc-1 --replicas=1
ffmpeg -i rtmp://backup-enc-1/stream -c copy s3://redwood-allhands/3325809999/backup-%03d.ts
```
Maya (Eng PM): Can we add a slide note reminding people to repeat audience questions verbally when we resume? That helps the recording and captioning.
Noah (Host): Yep — will instruct presenters. Also will prioritize roadmap Qs in the first 10 minutes of the Q&A block per Drew's ask.
Drew (CEO): Good call. If encoding instability continues, let's plan a short follow-up notes thread with timecodes and a TL;DR for folks who miss bits.
Recorder Bot: Backup recording live -> s3://redwood-allhands/backup/3325809999/stream-enc1-000.ts
Ravi (AV): Player switch complete, preview lag back to ~1s. Monitoring. Will keep encoder-3 logs for postmortem.
Eve (Events): Post-meeting tasks: 1) Ravi to attach logs and backup segments, 2) Recorder to publish stitched recording + markers, 3) Maya to update agenda slide and post pinned recording link, 4) Ops to file incident if CPU causes repeated encoder restarts.
Noah (Host): Announcing brief pause now. Resume in ~4 minutes; Q&A moved to the end (~17:50). Please drop questions here.
Maya (Eng PM): Thanks team. I'll draft the pinned TL;DR and include markers where we had the switch.
Drew (CEO): Appreciated the quick swap. :thumbsup:
Recorder Bot: Marker added at 00:11:15 noting encoder fallback -> s3://redwood-allhands/meta/3325809999/markers.json
Eve (Events): Resuming in 3m. Host, please remind people to repeat their question when called.
Noah (Host): Will do. Resuming shortly.
